contexts.text: They relate to the gross phlegm of the brain... whence come obstructions, from which are the beginnings of many diseases... AC 5726.
a. [5]. For all evil which is obstructed, increases... Therefore, lest any evil should be obstructed, everyone is permitted to think in favour of God, or against God...
(The effect on) heavenly truths in the understanding, if the evil love of the will were to be obstructed.
Those who live without use ... correspond to obstructions of the brain...
Sirens cause an obstruction of the hinder part of the cauda, where the spinal marrow ceases ...
